title: SUZHI dApp Frontend: Internet Identity auth + dashboard UI (wallet, contributions, governance)

requirements.summary: Integrate Internet Identity sign in/out and ensure authenticated backend calls use the logged-in principal.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can sign in with Internet Identity and see their authenticated principal in the UI (or equivalent logged-in state).
All authenticated actions (onboard, create work logs, verify, transfer, create proposal, vote) are performed using the logged-in identity.

file_operations.description: Create the root app component imported by frontend/src/main.tsx that gates all application data behind Internet Identity login (anonymous users see a login screen only). Use the selected authorization component’s frontend guidance for login/logout flows and cache clearing via React Query. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable login/logout button composed with existing hooks (useInternetIdentity) and React Query cache clearing on logout per the selected authorization component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add first-login profile setup modal (collect a display name) using backend getCallerUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile. Follow the selected authorization component’s recommendation to prevent modal flash by gating on actor readiness. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small auth helper hook (non-JSX) that derives isAuthenticated, principal string, and logout that clears React Query cache; compose useInternetIdentity and selected authorization component best practices. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create React Query hooks to load current user profile and role/admin status (getCallerUserProfile, getCallerUserRole, isCallerAdmin) and expose stable loading states for auth-gated UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Provide UI to create, view, and verify proof-of-contribution work logs with 2-peer verification status and rewarded/completed indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend provides a form to submit a work log with category and required fields (at minimum: description and time spent).
Backend stores work logs and their verification state in stable memory.
A work log can be verified by principals other than the worker; the same verifier cannot verify the same work log twice.
When the second valid verification is recorded, the reward is transferred automatically and the work log is marked as rewarded (cannot be rewarded again).
Frontend shows pending logs, verification count (0/2, 1/2, 2/2), and rewarded status.

file_operations.description: Create a work log submission form (category selector + description + time spent captured as start/end times) that calls createWorkLog and provides clear English validation/errors. Use shadcn-ui components for form inputs and dialogs where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a work log list UI that displays category, description, time span, validation count (0/2, 1/2, 2/2), and status (pending/completed) using data from getAllWorkLogs and/or getWorkLogsByCategory. Provide a verify action button that calls validateWorkLog, disabled when the current user is the worker. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks for listing work logs and mutations for createWorkLog/validateWorkLog, including query invalidation and error-to-UI mapping. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add small shared utilities for formatting work log category labels (Physical/Knowledge/Creative/Wellness), time spent calculation from start/end, and status labels in English.

requirements.summary: Build the Governance Portal UI to list proposals, show details with phase countdowns, allow submission, and allow token-weighted voting interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create proposals containing description, budget, and timeline.
Each proposal enforces timing: discussion phase lasts 7 days from creation; voting phase lasts the next 5 days; votes outside voting phase are rejected.
Voting power is proportional to SUZHI token holdings (document whether balance is measured at vote time or snapshotted; implementation must be consistent and testable).

Proposal outcome is computed at the end of the voting phase; if approval is >50% (clearly defined in code—e.g., yesVotes > noVotes and yesVotes / (yesVotes+noVotes) > 0.5), proposal is marked approved.

Approved proposals execute automatically with an on-chain effect (at minimum: mark executed + perform a deterministic action such as transferring the proposal budget from a defined DAO treasury/owner account to a specified recipient/creator).
Frontend includes a Governance Portal to list proposals, view details (including phase countdowns), submit proposals, and cast votes.

file_operations.description: Create a proposal submission form (title, description, budget, timeline/start time) that calls submitProposal and shows English success/error states. Use shadcn-ui components for form, inputs, and modal/sheet. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a proposal list that loads getAllDAOProposals and displays key fields plus computed phase (discussion/voting/ended) with countdown timers based on proposal.startTime and the 7-day + 5-day windows. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a proposal details view component that shows full description, votes (yes/no), current VotingStatus via getVotingStatus, and vote controls (Yes/No) during the voting phase. Use shadcn-ui components for layout and buttons. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks for proposal list, proposal status lookups, and mutations for submit proposal and voting (when backend capability is present), with proper invalidation and English error handling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add shared helpers for phase calculation (7-day discussion, 5-day voting), countdown formatting, and consistent display labels in English.

Align frontend TypeScript backend typings with the DAO voting backend capability used by the Governance Portal (add any missing voting method signatures required by the UI, keeping naming consistent with the generated backend declarations).

requirements.summary: Implement the SUZHI dashboard UI sections (Profile, Wallet, Contribution Logger, Governance Portal) with English text and required capabilities wired to backend calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard uses the specified palette consistently across navigation, background, buttons, and typography.
User Profile section shows the assigned sequential Citizen ID after onboarding.
Token Wallet section shows SUZHI balance and enables transfer to another principal.
Contribution Logger allows creating logs and verifying others’ logs where permitted.
Governance Portal lists proposals and supports proposal creation and voting with phase indicators.

file_operations.description: Create the main dashboard page that contains the four required sections: User Profile, Token Wallet, Contribution Logger, and Governance Portal. Use shadcn-ui layout primitives (cards/tabs) to organize sections and keep all user-facing text in English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a profile card that shows: display name (from UserProfile), authenticated principal string, and Citizen ID. Provide an 'Onboard' action that calls onboardCitizen(current principal) and then fetches getCitizenIdByPrincipal for display. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a wallet card showing SUZHI balance (getBalance) and a transfer form (to principal + amount) that calls transfer. Include an optional 'Buy SUZHI' placeholder UI with non-functional copy (per non-goals). Use shadcn-ui inputs/buttons. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks for balance fetching and transfer mutation with query invalidation and clear English error reporting. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks for onboarding and citizen ID fetching (onboardCitizen, getCitizenIdByPrincipal) keyed by current principal. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the Dashboard page into the root app UI (single-page layout is acceptable) and ensure navigation/section switching is available without creating orphan components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply an eco-city visual theme using the gold/brown/earthy palette consistently across the dashboard without adding new product features.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary CTAs use gold accents/gradients and remain accessible (sufficient contrast).
Background and surfaces use earthy browns/tans with readable sand/white text.
Styling is consistent across all dashboard sections (no mixed, unrelated themes).

file_operations.description: Create global styles and CSS variables used by Tailwind/shadcn theming to implement the required palette: Gold (#D4AF37), Brown (#4B3621), Earthy (#C2B280). Define background/surface/text defaults for an eco-city theme and ensure readable contrast.
Extend theme tokens (if needed) to support reusable eco-city palette utilities (e.g., semantic colors for primary/secondary/surface) while keeping styling consistent across the dashboard.

Create a shared app shell layout (header + content container) that applies the eco-city look: deep earthy background, cohesive spacing/typography, and gold-accent primary actions. Compose shadcn-ui components where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wrap authenticated views with AppShell to ensure consistent eco-city styling across Profile, Wallet, Contributions, and Governance sections. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
